useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

title:
The Calinski-Harabasz score, also known as Variance Ratio Criterion, is a clustering score defined as the ratio of
inter-cluster dispersion to intra-cluster dispersion. See
[sklearn reference](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/clustering.html#calinski-harabasz-index) for a detailed
formulation.

This metric **requires** `modelInput` as `context`. `modelInput` is the feature matrix used in clustering and must
have the same number of samples as the `modelOutput`.

**NOTE**: The current implementation materializes entire dataset in memory as opposed to batch computation.
name: MlCalinskiHarabaszMetric
